changelog: Wrong-cut reference fix: after the plugin discards a subtitle track that is not the same cut, the audio alignment now writes to a path of its own, so a leftover file from the discarded run can no longer be written to the library and reported as the audio's answer (the job refuses instead, as it should)
description: Synchronize subtitles with video audio using ffsubsync
name: SubSync
overview: Adds a Sync Subtitles action to any video, using ffsubsync as backend
